results.title: Traces of Justice
results.overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

results.title: Elisa
results.overview: Following a nuclear war, life on Earth has all but come to an end. Solisvita has placed a small group in an ancient cavern—equipped with a 180-day supply of water and provisions—tasking them with locating a rare "ore" essential for producing "Geneterna," a treatment designed to grant humans genetic immunity to radiation. Once the mission is complete, they are to be relocated to protected "Fortress Cities." However, communication with headquarters is severed, their water supply is running dangerously low, and with only eight days left in the mission, Emre—the project lead—takes his own life. Meanwhile, a mysterious stranger arrives at their door, sharing legends that hint at a hidden water source deep within the cavern. As trust begins to unravel, each member of the group is forced to confront the true cost of survival and the real nature of Solisvita—the organization they once believed to be their savior.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 10
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 10
results.overview: The tenth and final night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 8, 2026, at EDION Arena Osaka #2 in Osaka, Japan.

results.title: Just After Dawn
results.overview: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason.. and threatens their very existence.

results.title: The Stain
results.overview: When Malee, a young woman with a dark past, is drawn by fate to an apartment where she must confront haunting memories from her childhood, she encounters Pran, a botanist, a tea blending master, and the founder of a Thai floral tea brand.

results.title: Antiheroine
results.overview: Singer, songwriter, and actor Courtney Love has long had an impact on rock and pop culture. Now sober and set to release new music for the first time in over a decade, Courtney is ready to reveal her story, unfiltered and unapologetic.

results.title: Bad Apples
results.overview: Shocking deaths hit a small town after a troubled teen moves in with a picture-perfect foster family and clashes with their angelic daughter.

results.title: Yo, Narciso
results.overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

results.title: Matchmaking 3
results.overview: Baruch Auerbach, an unlucky-in-love Orthodox matchmaker from Bnei Brak, is finally engaged to struggling pastry chef Ruth but their financial woes make the loved-up pair’s dream wedding impossible.  When American Jewish Orthodox millionaire Michael Gerstel offers a $100,000 to anyone capable of finding a suitable match for his only daughter, Baruch is left with no option but to reunite with his mentor/adversary, Malki, for the matchmaking mission of-a-lifetime.

results.title: Phi Phong: The Blood Demon
results.original_title: Phí Phông: Quỷ Máu Rừng Thiêng
results.overview: Phí Phông—a bloodthirsty demon from the mountain folk legends that has haunted generations. The film follows Còn (Kiều Minh Tuấn) and Dương (Minh Anh), two apprentice shamans who journey into the mountains to save their mother, who has fallen under the Phí Phông curse. At the same time, a series of gruesome deaths begin to plague a remote village, casting suspicion on Mon (Diệp Bảo Ngọc) and her daughter Lua (Nina Nutthacha), who exhibit traits eerily similar to the demon. Yet, buried deep within the cursed forest lie shocking secrets, drawing Còn and Dương into an endless hunt for the true face of Phí Phông.

results.title: At Night
results.overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

results.title: Whole Head Vacation
results.overview: Anna, a wedding planner from Moscow, comes to visit her sick grandmother. To cheer up her grandmother, the girl passes off a colleague as the groom, and random fellow travelers as his parents. But everything gets out of control: a hunt for ancient treasure, mafia, secret services, chases and family secrets. Now Anna needs not only to sort out this chaos, but also to find at least one person she can trust.

results.title: Couples Weekend
results.overview: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

results.title: Pasakalye
results.overview: Brotherhood versus Duty. Two childhood friends will have the greatest ride of their lives as they find themselves up against each other. Who will rule the streets?

results.title: Perfect Love
results.overview: At the brink of giving up on all human connection, a painfully inhibited young woman meets a self-loving stranger at New York's Coney Island, inspiring her to ride a rollercoaster–for real and in her own bedroom...

results.title: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra
results.original_title: Μία μέρα στη ζωή της Τζο: Κεφάλαιο Φαίδρα
results.overview: Jo, 15, melancholic and wild, feels shy about her music taste. Phaedra's ethereal song moves her deeply. Between breaths, she writes a poem, cuts an apology rose for her moody mom, but can't recall last night's dream. A day of shifts.

results.title: Behind the Palm Trees
results.overview: Mehdi leads an exemplary life with his family and Selma, his new girlfriend in Marrakech. For the young couple, things are going smoothly until Mehdi meets Marie, a young French woman caught up in the social life of the expatriate community.

results.title: Satanist Interview
results.overview: Six satanists are interviewed for GQ.

results.title: Mallbound
results.overview: Parker Shaw is a Content Creator who makes urban exploration videos. His latest investigation took place at the old condemned mall in his hometown, where a woman named Dana Morgan took her own life. In response to internet backlash against the footage he captured, he now presents his raw files from that fateful night...

results.title: Three widows
results.overview: Brenda Romo, a strong women who grew up in the town of Jesús María, Jalisco, wants to study and become a "maestra tequilera"; those who overview the process in which Tequila is made. She'll have to face the outdated ideas of his town and an industry dominated by men who deem her less for being a woman.  Through the strength and unconditional support of her mother, Brenda manages to become a successful maestra tequilera, and opens up possibilities for her younger sister; showing her there isn't just one road for her future.  Three widows is a short documentary that follows the proffesional life and struggles of maestra tequilera, Brenda Romo.
